In this eye-opening video, we delve into the groundbreaking steps India is taking towards adopting blockchain technology with a special focus on the Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC). As the digital era evolves, India is not just following but leading in some aspects. This comprehensive guide will explain the intricacies of CBDC, its potential impact on the Indian economy, and how it differentiates from cryptocurrencies.
